Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin Capital Movements skill and memory.

Key lesson saved:
For named-currency liability shares like Canadian dollar liabilities out of total liabilities to foreign countries, the denominator is the grand “Total liabilities to foreign countries” series, not the subtotal of liabilities payable in foreign currencies. Using the foreign-currency subtotal gives an inflated share, matching the wrong 0.029-style magnitude instead of the correct ~0.005.
